sections.Profile:
Stern's Elvis pinball machine, released by Stern in 2004 and designed by Steve Ritchie, celebrates the life and music of Elvis Presley. This game features an array of Elvis's hit songs, including "Hound Dog" and "Jailhouse Rock," with actual singing by Elvis and voiceovers by Jamie Kelley and Al Dvorin. The gameplay includes unique elements such as an animated Elvis figure that performs signature moves and a mini-playfield themed after "Heartbreak Hotel."
